meta_title: Synergy Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Middlesbrough
meta_description: Synergy Plumbing & Heating Services in Middlesbrough. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating maintenance. Gas Safe registered. Same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? We're with you in under an hour, every day of the year.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Middlesbrough
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new boiler installations, we handle every aspect of your plumbing and heating needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most faults same day, even outside normal hours.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with 10-year warranty. We'll remove the old unit, install to Building Regulations, and leave your system running efficiently.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Maintenance
services.desc: Annual gas boiler safety checks keep your warranty valid and heating costs down. We spot small problems before they become expensive breakdowns.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots in your radiators? We'll bleed, balance, or replace them. Includes checks for sludge and chemical flush if needed.

services.title: Central Heating System Installation
services.desc: Complete system design and installation, from pipework to controls. Energy-efficient and fully commissioned with all safety checks included.

services.title: Pipework & Leak Detection
services.desc: Water leaks hidden behind walls or under floors? We use non-invasive detection to pinpoint the problem, then repair or replace the damaged section.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing homeowners ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Synergy Plumbing & Heating was founded in 2006 by a Gas Safe registered engineer frustrated with the lack of honest, fast plumbing service in Middlesbrough. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, fixing the job right, and charging a fair price. Today we're the go-to emergency plumber for hundreds of local families and landlords.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is simple: we answer our phone 24/7, we carry parts on the van, and we won't try to sell you work you don't need. Repeat customers make up 65% of our business—that tells you everything. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a new boiler installation, you'll get the same quality and honest advice.
reviews_heading: What Middlesbrough Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe in the kitchen just before Christmas. Rang Synergy and they had someone round within 45 minutes. Brilliant service, very professional, fair price. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had our boiler replaced last spring. The lads were tidy, explained everything they were doing, and left everything spotless. System's been running perfectly. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Called them at 11pm with a leaking radiator. They talked me through a temporary fix and then came out first thing the next morning. Honest, quick, and they didn't charge a fortune. Will use again.
reviews.author: Paul T.
